Four training programs cover classroom AI literacy with Malaysia's Ministry of Education and Raspberry Pi Foundation, microentrepreneur clinics, AI tools for 19 local councils, and Data Center Institutes in polytechnics from 2027. Digital Minister Gobind Singh Deo called it "a high standard for sustainable, high-impact digital infrastructure development." Selangor capacity will also back Google's coming Malaysian cloud region. Lee said the bill "will make South Korea a leader and secure its dominance in the future while turning national growth into growth for the people". Alongside those megaprojects, 13.8 trillion won goes to ten strategic technology fields and 2.1 trillion won to electricity, water and industrial complex infrastructure for chip plants. Defense spending rises 8.2% to 73.3 trillion won, with Lee pledging to transform the military into "a smart, elite force" through manned and unmanned systems based on AI, robots and drones, plus nuclear-powered submarines and KF-21 fighters.

The budget leans on a forecast 30.4% jump in revenue to 880.8 trillion won, per The Korea Herald, with a 162.3 trillion won Future Response Fund channeling chip-boom tax receipts; 45.4 trillion won of it is spent next year on youth programs, growth industries, regional development and education, and what remains reduces bond issuance and builds reserves. The administration projects its managed deficit narrowing to 0.1% of GDP from 3.9% and debt falling to 48.3% of GDP from 51.6%. Opposition People Power Party lawmakers interrupted with shouts of "That makes no sense." Lee asked for passage by a December 2 legal deadline. lenacapavir-africa-rollout-2026.summary: PURPOSE 1, a trial published in the New England Journal of Medicine in July 2024, recorded zero HIV infections among 2,134 young women in South Africa and Uganda given lenacapavir injections every six months. The FDA approved it for prevention in June 2025. Under a Global Fund and PEPFAR arrangement with Gilead, which forgoes profit until generics arrive, first shipments reached Eswatini and Zambia in November 2025 and dosing began in December. About 20,000 people had started by end of May 2026, 49,000 by June, and around 100,000 by mid-August across nine countries including Kenya, Nigeria, Zimbabwe and South Africa; some 191,620 doses had been shipped by July. In Eswatini 10,000 doses sat undistributed. The goal is 3 million people by end-2028, with licensed generics at about 40 dollars a year expected from 2027.

Chi Onwurah, chair of Parliament's Science and Technology Committee, said it showed 'the lack of resilience in the U.K.'s digital infrastructure'; Germany's digital ministry spokesperson Florian Druckenthaner told reporters the German economy would be significantly affected, per Politico. AP drew parallels to CrowdStrike's July 2024 faulty update, which grounded flights and hit hospitals. Downdetector logged reports from 74 countries and territories within an hour, AP reported. Microsoft's Friday statement traced it to an issue 'during an earlier network capacity upgrade that surfaced following a recent network change'. CBS News and AP, updated Nov 14, put Microsoft's first alert just before 1 pm ET Thursday and Downdetector's Thursday user reports above 130,000. Charles Lamanna, Microsoft's executive vice president for Copilot, Agents and Platform, posted at 22:02 UTC Friday that investigation 'points to technical challenges and failure modes (cascading failures + thundering herds at our network perimeter)', a thundering herd, in computing, being many processes woken at once to contend for one resource, and that a post-mortem with 'the step-by-step timeline and our many repair items' would follow. Australia's Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke told reporters in Sydney that Microsoft likened it to CrowdStrike: 'an update that has gone awry', per CBS. Microsoft 365 Status posted at 05:48 UTC on Monday, Nov 16 that Microsoft had released a Preliminary Post-Incident Report on last week's outage, available to administrators in Microsoft 365 admin center under incidents MO1550821 and EX1550543; no public copy accompanied that post. Lamanna posted an abridged version of that preliminary report on X at 06:06 UTC Nov 16, naming three factors: a latent defect in Microsoft 365 networking gateway servers, 'lock contention inside an internal process', shipped in a fix whose deployment began in July and ran worldwide for more than three months without impact; a Teams failover onto that gateway roughly fifteen hours before impact, which raised its load; and 'nearly 14% of server capacity' already out of service from an unrelated issue. Calder McHugh of Politico, which first reported it, quoted Wing on 'swarms of autonomous agents acting independently and without control' and noted researchers will only see what companies must disclose publicly, since models still in development stay private; Will Shanklin of Engadget made a similar point.
